headline: Wesfarmers lithium division reaches above-nameplate production and approves concentrator capacity doubling, with first profit achieved
reasoning: Gianotti reported that the Wesfarmers lithium mining concentrator produced 209,000 tonnes in FY25 (50% share), exceeding the nameplate capacity of 190,000 tonnes. A final investment decision has been made to double the concentrator capacity, with first product from the expanded facility expected in approximately three years. The lithium refinery producing lithium hydroxide has faced odour issues but is producing quality product and is progressing customer qualification processes, with an accelerated ramp expected in the second half of FY25. Recent stronger lithium prices enabled the division to record its first profit in the financial year.
quote: Lithium was one of our growth legs. We invested in a few years ago, pleasingly this financial year, you saw that we've got our mining concentrator above nameplate capacity. So we produced 209,000 tons this financial year, which is our 50% share. And that's above nameplate capacity of 190,000 tons. So that's travelling really well. And in fact, you will have seen that we've announced final investment decision to expand double the capacity of that concentrator. And we'll kick that project off now. And we should have our first product in about three years time. So that's really an exciting part of what we're doing in lithium. And of course lithium prices have been quite strong recently and that's allowed us to make our first profit. This financial year, we're also obviously continuing with our lithium refinery to produce lithium hydroxide. We had we have had a few odor issues with that plant, but pleasingly it is producing quality product.
episode_title: Wesfarmers relies on Bunnings boost and Kmart charge

headline: Lithium prices have strengthened recently, enabling first profit from lithium operations

This price backdrop also underpinned the confidence to make a final investment decision to double concentrator capacity.
